denomination.name: Teef
denomination.summary: The base teef. One teef is the atomic unit of the island currency. The ghost is the TEEFZ logo and the default picture. The 64-sprite sheet is more pictures of the same coin, not the logo.

denomination.name: Jaw
denomination.summary: Sixteen teef. The hotel treats two jaws as one mouf.

denomination.name: Mouf
denomination.summary: Thirty-two teef. Two jaws, or thirty-two loose teef.

denomination.name: Skull
denomination.summary: One hundred twenty-eight teef. Four moufs.

denomination.name: SkeleTonne
denomination.summary: One thousand twenty-four teef. Eight skulls. The largest island note.

denomination.name: 0.01 SMILE
denomination.summary: The smallest card balance. One atomic cent, shown as 0.01 SMILE.

denomination.name: 0.05 SMILE
denomination.summary: Five cents on the Smiley Tooth card.

denomination.name: 0.25 SMILE
denomination.summary: A quarter SMILE on the card.

denomination.name: 0.50 SMILE
denomination.summary: Half a SMILE on the card.

denomination.name: 1 SMILE
denomination.summary: One SMILE on the card. One hundred atomic cents.

denomination.name: 4 SMILE
denomination.summary: Four SMILE on the card.

denomination.name: 11 SMILE
denomination.summary: Eleven SMILE on the card.

denomination.name: 44 SMILE
denomination.summary: Forty-four SMILE on the card.

denomination.name: 88 SMILE
denomination.summary: Eighty-eight SMILE on the card.

denomination.name: 222 SMILE
denomination.summary: Two hundred twenty-two SMILE on the card.

denomination.name: 777 SMILE
denomination.summary: Seven hundred seventy-seven SMILE on the card. The largest card face.

denomination.name: 0.01 SMILE note
denomination.summary: Paper worth 0.01 SMILE. It does not break into smaller notes at a shop.

denomination.name: 0.05 SMILE note
denomination.summary: Paper worth 0.05 SMILE. Exact inventory.

denomination.name: 0.25 SMILE note
denomination.summary: Paper worth 0.25 SMILE. Exact inventory.

denomination.name: 0.50 SMILE note
denomination.summary: Paper worth 0.50 SMILE. Exact inventory.

denomination.name: 1 SMILE note
denomination.summary: A one SMILE note. Some counters take this and refuse the card.

denomination.name: 4 SMILE note
denomination.summary: A four SMILE note. Exact inventory.

denomination.name: 11 SMILE note
denomination.summary: An eleven SMILE note. Exact inventory.

denomination.name: 44 SMILE note
denomination.summary: A forty-four SMILE note. Exact inventory.

denomination.name: 88 SMILE note
denomination.summary: An eighty-eight SMILE note. Exact inventory.

denomination.name: 222 SMILE note
denomination.summary: A two hundred twenty-two SMILE note. Exact inventory.

denomination.name: 777 SMILE note
denomination.summary: A seven hundred seventy-seven SMILE note. It spends as that note. It does not shatter.

denomination.name: S1
denomination.summary: One slime credit. The circle-family glyph S1, which already means 1 in the tracker.

denomination.name: S2
denomination.summary: Two slime. Two S1 coins make one S2.

denomination.name: S3
denomination.summary: Three slime.

denomination.name: S4
denomination.summary: Four slime.

denomination.name: S5
denomination.summary: Five slime.

denomination.name: S6
denomination.summary: Six slime.

denomination.name: S7
denomination.summary: Seven slime. The last single digit of the circle family.

denomination.name: S10
denomination.summary: Eight slime, written S1 S0. S0 still means zero in the tracker and is not its own coin.

item.name: Padpear
item.summary: A modular XY pad that grows on Stardrain trees like a pear.

item.name: Sine Berry
item.summary: An oscillator berry with a sine wave. It is not change for another waveform.

item.name: Square Berry
item.summary: An oscillator berry with a square wave.

item.name: Saw Berry
item.summary: An oscillator berry with a saw wave.

item.name: Pulse Berry
item.summary: An oscillator berry with a pulse wave.

item.name: Noise Berry
item.summary: An oscillator berry that puts out noise.

item.name: Cable Vine
item.summary: A patch cable that grows as a vine. Copies of this one id stack.

item.name: Drum Module
item.summary: A drum voice that grows on the island. It is not three smaller drum voices.

item.name: Sampler Pod
item.summary: A sampler cultivar. It plays recorded audio in a rig.

item.name: Sequencer Stalk
item.summary: A sequencer that grows as a stalk and clocks the rest of a rig.

item.name: Mixer Blossom
item.summary: An audio mixer that grows in Hollywood Cowboy's garden.

item.name: Audio Driver
item.summary: The output driver of a rig. Classed as a fixture until a craft review says otherwise.

item.name: Filter Frond
item.summary: A filter module grown as a frond.

item.name: Tape Reel
item.summary: A tape transport grown on the island.

item.name: CD Fruit
item.summary: A CD player that fruits on a Stardrain plant.

item.name: Video Mixer
item.summary: A video mixer cultivar. Classed as a fixture until a craft review says otherwise.

item.name: Synth Voice
item.summary: A housed synthesizer voice. It is a different good from a single oscillator berry.

item.name: Chorus Moss
item.summary: A chorus send, the moss cultivar. Classed as a fixture until a craft review says otherwise.

item.name: Flanger Moss
item.summary: A flanger send. Classed as a fixture until a craft review says otherwise.

item.name: Delay Pod
item.summary: A delay or repeat send. Classed as a fixture until a craft review says otherwise.

item.name: Monorave Pod
item.summary: The island cultivar for the Thrash Tracker monorave layer. Not sold in Mediocricity.

item.name: Island Drum Pack
item.summary: A drum pack sold on the island for TEEFZ. It is not the Mediocricity pack.

item.name: YM2612 Chip
item.summary: The YM2612 layer as a city import. Bought with SMILE. It does not grow on the island.

item.name: Label Drum Pack
item.summary: Smiley Teeth's drum pack. SMILE only. It does not exchange for the island pack.

item.name: Broadcast Limiter
item.summary: The limiter Smiley Teeth requires before the bubble will air a piece. You keep it. You do not spend it as change.
